title: Archive clients instead of deleting them
summary: Clients get an archived status. The list can filter on it, a client page can archive and restore, and a migration adds the column for existing clients.

prerequisites.text: Test admin account (credentials shown on this page)

steps.title: Client list
steps.page: The list now shows each client's status. Archived clients carry a grey tag.

decisions.text: Sorted by name only, no per-column sorting.
decisions.cost: Column sorting would have to be added.

points.title: Status filter
points.do: Switch the status filter between All, Active and Archived.

doubts.text: Archived clients stay visible by default.

points.title: Search
points.do: Search for "Bist", then for a name that does not exist.

steps.title: Create a client
steps.page: The creation form: name, VAT number and status.

points.title: Creation
points.do: Create "Bistro Test" with a VAT number.

decisions.cost: A required-field rule and a migration for clients without one.

points.title: Required name
points.do: Submit the form without a name.

next.instruction: Open the client you just created

steps.title: Archive and restore
steps.page: Bistro Test's page, with the new Archive button. An archived client shows a banner and a Restore button.

points.title: Restoring
points.do: Restore the archived client from its page.

decisions.text: Only admins can restore a client.

steps.title: Archived status migration
steps.page: The migration adds an archived_at column, empty for existing clients.

points.title: Existing clients
points.do: Existing clients stay active after the migration.

decisions.text: archived_at stays empty for existing clients.
